name: toastty
description: Managed-session workflows for controlling and supporting Toastty from coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Control and support Toastty from managed agent sessions.
interface.longDescription: Toastty adds workflows for app control, Scratchpad visuals, local-document review, sibling-terminal reads, redacted diagnostics, and safe worktree handoffs. Toastty exposes these skills only to supported managed agent sessions.
defaultPrompt: Show this plan in Toastty for review.
Create a visual summary in Scratchpad.
Check what the dev server in the other terminal is printing.
Move this task into a new worktree.
